discovery.about: obscura-js, the V8 JavaScript runtime built on deno_core: the browser bootstrap shim, Rust ops bridging JS to the DOM and network, frames, modules and watchdogs.
discovery.see: The browser environment shim run in every page realm (about 800 KB): captures the privileged deno_core bridge privately, hides internal globals from enumeration, and implements document, window, navigator, location, events, observers, fetch and XHR, storage, crypto, Workers and many other Web APIs over Rust ops.

ObscuraJsRuntime, the per-page V8 isolate owner (largest file in the crate): isolate construction and serialization across threads, script and module evaluation, event loop driving with bounded settle, the termination watchdog, CDP remote objects and console and exception events, render geometry and resource requests.

Rust ops called from bootstrap.js: op_dom for all DOM mutations and queries wrapped in catch_unwind, fetch and XHR through the page transport with interception (InterceptedRequest and InterceptResolution), network event recording, navigation timing, frames, crypto and the per-page ObscuraState.
Child frame realms: each iframe gets its own JavaScript realm, DOM tree and origin so scripts inside frames run, with messaging and lifecycle between parent and child documents.

ObscuraModuleLoader for ES modules: fetches module graphs through the page transport, tracks observable network activity of dynamic imports so lifecycle idleness is accurate, and applies the module budget.
Import map support for ES modules: parses imports and scopes from page import maps and resolves bare and remapped specifiers, recording resolved modules.
The per-document input stream behind document.write(): a tokenizer that keeps state across calls so a construct may be split anywhere, even inside a tag name, while inserting parsed nodes in place.

Shared per-command V8 watchdog for the CDP server: one long-lived thread enforces deadlines for every in-flight command and terminates the isolate when the budget expires, instead of a thread per command.
Process-wide V8 flag handling: records when the first runtime is constructed and drops later set_v8_flags calls instead of aborting, so --v8-flags only applies at startup.
The shared JavaScript expression that walks document.body and returns Markdown, used by the CLI --dump markdown mode and the LP.getMarkdown CDP method.

Build script that creates the V8 startup snapshot containing bootstrap.js, using the host V8 for native builds and a cross mksnapshot binary when cross-compiling so the snapshot matches the target architecture.
Tests that several runtimes on one thread can be used and dropped out of creation order, and that runtime futures and module loads can be interleaved on one thread.
Tests that switching prefers-reduced-motion refreshes existing computed style objects, updates matchMedia queries with change events and invalidates CSS geometry.
Tests that MediaQueryList delivers change events and honors listener add and remove lifecycle, and that the onchange property handler is independent of listeners and keeps their order.
